title: Design System: Personal Workspace — The Quiet Studio

scope.appliesTo: .portfolio-page on the public homepage and /banner review route
scope.mechanism: Homepage tokens are --pf-* custom properties defined on .portfolio-page and overridden by .dark .portfolio-page in src/app/banner/banner.css.
scope.coexistsWith: The authenticated app's established semantic-token and teal product system. The homepage world does not replace, extend, or harmonize that system.

midnight-paper.purpose: Night homepage ground and the neutral mixed into the hero's dark overlay.

warm-surface-2.purpose: Daylight hover fill and quiet interaction well.

midnight-surface-2.purpose: Night hover fill and quiet interaction well.

ink.purpose: Daylight headings, navigation, body copy, and brand.

chalk.purpose: Night headings, navigation, body copy, and solid action fill.

muted-ink.purpose: Daylight supporting copy and secondary footer language.

muted-chalk.purpose: Night supporting copy and secondary footer language.

soft-ink.purpose: Daylight hero second line, kickers, and least-prominent labels.

soft-chalk.purpose: Night hero second line, kickers, and least-prominent labels.

action-light.purpose: Solid pill action in the light theme.

action-dark.purpose: Solid pill action in the dark theme.

focus-light.purpose: Two-pixel keyboard focus outline in daylight.

focus-dark.purpose: Warm two-pixel keyboard focus outline at night.

display.purpose: The oversized homepage h1, including its muted second line.

label.purpose: Rare uppercase kickers and the scroll cue.

quote.purpose: The single self-hosted Cormorant Garamond quote moment.

motion.name: theme-crossfade
motion.purpose: Cross-fades paired daylight and night photography.

motion.name: state-standard
motion.purpose: Button, navigation, and control state changes.

motion.name: arrow-response
motion.purpose: Moves action arrows 2px right and up on hover.

motion.name: photo-drift
motion.purpose: Slowly scales a workspace-card photograph from 1.01 to 1.055.

motion.name: scroll-cue
motion.purpose: Moves the hero scroll arrow 7px vertically.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Compresses homepage transitions and animations when reduced motion is preferred.

imagery.rule: Every meaningful photograph uses a dark canonical source and a daylight lighting-only edit with matching subject, pose, crop, geometry, and focal point. The light image carries the useful alt text; the dark duplicate uses empty alt text.

narrative.overview:
The public homepage is a cinematic editorial portrait of a personal working life. It pairs generous, asymmetrical type with real photographic atmosphere: a focused desk anchors the opening viewport, three tall image-led cards turn the live workspace areas into places rather than software tiles, a split about section shifts the rhythm, and a coast image gives the serif quote a quiet closing breath. Content, controls, and icons remain semantic DOM layered over separate image assets; the page is never a flattened screenshot.

Day and night are parallel art directions, not a filter applied after the fact. Every meaningful photograph has an authored light and dark counterpart, cross-faded by the existing theme state. The palette follows that imagery with warm paper and near-black in daylight, then graphite and chalk after dark. The design is expressive but restrained: compact navigation, heavy sans display type, a muted second headline line, one italic studio note, pill actions, fine rules, and very little decoration beyond photography.
keyCharacteristics: Asymmetric, photo-led hero with editorial type placed in the quiet side of the image.
Paired daylight and night photography for every major image-bearing region.
Warm-neutral monochrome palettes with no homepage brand accent competing with the photographs.
Heavy Plus Jakarta Sans display type with a muted second line; Cormorant Garamond is reserved for the coast quote.
Full-pill actions and theme control; cards remain gently squared.
Three photographic workspace cards, a split about image, a compact tools strip, a quote band, and a quiet contact/footer close.
Semantic HTML and separate images at every layer; never a screenshot of composed text or controls.

rules.name: The Photograph Carries Colour Rule
rules.body: Homepage UI remains warm-neutral. Do not introduce a general-purpose accent; colour comes from the paired photography and the small, truthful brand colours inside tool logos.

rules.name: The Paired Scene Rule
rules.body: A meaningful homepage photograph ships as a light/dark pair with matched subject, crop, and narrative purpose. Theme changes must feel like time passing in the same world, not navigation to a different page.

rules.name: The Scoped World Rule
rules.body: `--pf-*` belongs under `.portfolio-page`. The authenticated app's semantic tokens remain authoritative everywhere else.

rules.name: The Muted Second Line Rule
rules.body: The second line of the hero headline is the same type, weight, size, and rhythm as the first; only its soft neutral colour changes.

rules.name: The One Serif Moment Rule
rules.body: Cormorant Garamond belongs to the coast quote and nowhere else. Repeating it in cards or section headings would turn a singular pause into a theme.

rules.name: The Quiet-Side Rule
rules.body: Place hero copy in the image's low-detail zone and tune the theme-specific gradient to preserve both typography and the photographic subject.

rules.name: The Editorial Sequence Rule
rules.body: Keep the page rhythm: hero → three workspace photographs → split about → compressed tools strip → full-width quote image → contact/footer. New content must justify breaking that sequence instead of inserting a generic band.

rules.name: The No Floating Card Rule
rules.body: Cards stay on the page plane with one hairline and clipped photography. Do not add box shadows, glow, or hover lift.

rules.name: The Image-First Depth Rule
rules.body: Use crop, overlay, light, and restrained image scale to create depth. UI chrome must remain quiet enough that the photograph leads.

dos: Do keep this system inside `.portfolio-page` and preserve the authenticated app's existing visual language.
Do ship every major photograph as coordinated light and dark files under `public/Images/portfolio/`.
Do keep text, links, icons, and controls as semantic DOM layered over separate image assets.
Do preserve the heavy first-line / muted second-line hero hierarchy.
Do use Cormorant Garamond only for the coast quote.
Do use hairlines, tonal changes, overlays, and image crop for hierarchy before adding decoration.
Do preserve real focus states, useful alt text on the light image, empty alt text on its dark duplicate, and the reduced-motion fallback.
donts: Don't flatten the composition into a screenshot or bake text and controls into an image.
Don't apply homepage `--pf-*` values to authenticated screens or redesign product primitives to match this page.
Don't introduce a general brand accent; photography carries the colour.
Don't add shadows, hover lift, or large rounded marketing panels.
Don't use Cormorant for headings, navigation, cards, or body copy.
Don't substitute one photograph plus CSS filters for the authored day/night pairs.
Don't promise collaboration, integrations, social proof, or deferred product features in homepage copy.
